# [TASK] Frontend: dictation language switch (English/German)

## Task
Add a language switch to the frontend, wired to the speech-to-text request
and persisted across sessions.

## Scope
UI control and its wiring only — assumes #212's backend language
parameter already exists.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] A visible EN/DE switch near/on `VoiceControl.jsx` (or in settings/NavBar, reviewer's call on placement) sets the active dictation language
- [x] The selected language is sent with every `/speech-to-text` request until changed
- [x] Selection persists across page reloads (e.g. localStorage), defaulting to English for first-time users
- [x] Switching language mid-session doesn't require a page reload or break an in-progress recording

## Estimate
**Hours:** 4

## Notes
A small `ToggleButtonGroup` (EN/DE) above the VoiceControl Fab, backed by `dictationLanguage.js` (`getDictationLanguage`/`setDictationLanguage`), mirroring the `getBackendTarget`/`setBackendTarget` localStorage pattern in `apiUrl.js`. Persists under `lmdb_dictation_language`, validates against `['en','de']`, defaults to `en` for a first-time or corrupted value.

`VoiceControl.jsx` reads the selection into a `languageRef` rather than raw state, so a switch made after recording starts is still picked up when the request is sent — `MediaRecorder.onstop` is bound once per recording and would otherwise close over a stale value.
